data.narrative:
Allen Control Systems is a Series B defense and security company founded by Mike Wior, Steve Simoni, and Luke Allen, currently seeking valuation guidance after raising $200M to date. The peer universe consists of 10 comparables spanning 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms operating in the same sector and stage.

Stage-progression analysis was not applicable due to data integrity concerns; the reported $2.2B last post-money valuation implies a multiple exceeding 20x total capital raised, suggesting a tracking error. Peer-median valuation, applied across 7 same-sector, same-stage private companies, yielded $1.0B. The peer set ranged from $300M to $3.0B, with identified comparables including Dream Security at $3.0B, Harmattan AI at $1.4B, Code Metal at $1.2B, and Twenty and Defense Unicorns each at $1.0B.

This analysis supports a valuation range of $850M to $1.1B, centered on $1.0B. The single-method result reflects reliance on peer multiples alone; the range captures reasonable variance within the observed peer distribution. Key uncertainties include the composition and quality of the peer set—particularly whether Dream Security's $3.0B valuation reflects comparable business model, stage, or risk profile—and the absence of revenue-based or DCF anchoring. Additional data on Allen Control Systems' revenue, growth rate, and specific competitive positioning would materially improve confidence in this range.
